No invented effective date for absent or truncated text. Changed revision names June-to-September; unchanged revision has no changes.

findings.qualification: High reasoning alone does not recover all foreigner-specific content. The precision_v1 role-prioritization prompt is still being tested on the corresponding revision case.

findings.source_fact: The supplied project is a bilateral-agreement ratification; the scoring rubric explicitly assigns ratifications importance 2. Luna gives employment 4 while acknowledging unchanged Polish entry/work permit requirements.
findings.qualification: The factual ICT durations match the supplied agreement. This is ranking and publication consistency, not a fabricated permit exemption.

findings.source_fact: The supplied full text includes passport/identity-data alternatives to PESEL and EU healthcare-coordination identifiers, both highlighted in the saved Opus reference. Luna provides a generic medicine-reimbursement summary without these specific foreign-patient procedures.
findings.qualification: Correct publication score and entry dates alone do not establish equal reader usefulness.

findings.source_fact: Article 6 excludes persons already in a foreign-law cohabitation union not recognized as marriage under Polish law. Luna omits this foreigner-specific eligibility restriction and the lack of new residence rights, both present in the saved reference.
findings.qualification: The current answer does not expressly claim a residence right or universal eligibility, but loses useful conditions for the target audience.

findings.source_fact: The 583180-token budget text is processed successfully and the reported aid allocations and effective date match the saved reference, but Luna gives social/3 to ordinary budget financing while expressly stating no new rights or eligibility rules. Historical Opus gives marginal/1.
findings.qualification: This would add a general-budget card under the production score >=3 gate. It shows editorial ranking drift despite accurate numbers; strong context capacity is not sufficient for full replacement.

findings.source_fact: High also assigns social/3 to the annual budget while explicitly stating no new rights, applications or eligibility. Higher reasoning alone does not fix this editorial drift.

findings.qualification: The original medium failure remains evidence of variability; this targeted repair is not an original blind heldout result.

findings.source_fact: Restores language-course and medical-graduate insurance groups and stops treating newly noticed details as established legislative changes.

findings.case: reanalysis-RCL_12412454 precision_v1 medium/high and high original
findings.source_fact: All three exploratory rechecks still omit language-course participants. The stronger max_v2 instruction explicitly prioritizes these groups and is rerun on all real primary/revision contexts.
Original high calls a detail absent from the short prior description a change. precision_v1 medium/high leave changes empty, while the new 100->200 fee control still names the real change.

Both modes preserve the positive Ukraine-special-act scan. none rejects the farmer-ombudsman scan; medium passes it due to citizenship restrictions for a single public office. No independent broad-negative legal gold was assigned to that scan.

The supplied control explicitly gives holders of valid permanent residence the right to return to Poland after travel. Original medium/high and precision medium score it legal_stay/5; precision high scores it indirect/2 while preserving the facts.
findings.qualification: The production rubric explicitly assigns entry/exit and immigration control score 2, but changes to permanent residence score 5. This short control grants return after travel without changing the residence permit itself, so score 2 is defensible. The old score-5 answer is not a legal oracle, and no score expectation was preregistered. Report classification instability, not an established publication false negative.

findings.source_fact: The supplied operative text requires Poland/EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship, adequate Polish, age 25 and five years of practice. It also permits appointing another knowledgeable person where appointing a registered expert is impossible or difficult. Luna correctly preserves that exception; the historical Opus practical-impact text is more absolute about third-country exclusion.
findings.coverage_limit: Luna omits the supplied authenticated-translation and no-PESEL identity-document requirements, and does not explicitly name eligible EU/EEA/Swiss foreign candidates in affected_groups. Its core citizenship rule and dates match the source.

findings.source_fact: The supplied justification identifies an actual access problem: uninsured HIV patients cannot afford visits or diagnostic services needed to receive treatment. The bill expressly funds related healthcare for those without insurance entitlement. Luna preserves this practical effect and the 14-day vacatio.
findings.qualification: Luna social/3 versus historical Opus indirect/2 is defensible under the rubric for changed access to healthcare. Do not classify all baseline publication disagreements as Luna errors. This is not equivalent to the unchanged annual-budget allocations in 3150.

findings.source_fact: The supplied text repeals art. 3a of the foreigner real-estate acquisition law but does not reproduce that article. Luna honestly says the precise consequence is unavailable from the supplied bill; historical GPT-5.1 also supplies no precise consequence despite assigning score 3.
findings.external_source_fact: In the consolidated version cited in the bill, art. 3a sets a one-month decision period for property in a special economic zone. This is outside the model's supplied input; 2026 amendments are not verified by this older consolidation alone.
findings.qualification: Luna score 2 versus the reference score 3 cannot be treated as a proven substantive legal error from reference disagreement alone. A production reader-facing analysis would benefit from retrieving the repealed provision.

findings.source_fact: Preserves the patient non-discrimination rule by citizenship/nationality without overriding separate eligibility rules, the medical-worker time/pay restrictions, half-time minimum for specified hospital personnel, six-month contract-adjustment window and one-month vacatio.
findings.qualification: The short answer does not enumerate every pay cap; this review establishes the listed core conditions, not exhaustive coverage of all institutional provisions.

findings.source_fact: The supplied bill permits employers subject to national restrictive measures to apply for FGSP payments protecting specified employee claims. Luna lists affected workers but omits this available protection from the summary, key_changes and practical_impact; the saved Opus reference includes it.
findings.qualification: Luna correctly preserves undesirable-stay listing, the 20-million-zloty penalty cap and effective dates. The missing wage-protection route is a reader-usefulness loss rather than an invented sanction.

findings.source_fact: The reference and supplied Jamboree bill contain a criminal-record-document requirement for volunteers from outside the EU, covering citizenship and residence states over ten years. Luna's four bullets focus on visas and omit this distinct volunteer obligation.
findings.qualification: The visa-fee waiver, participation evidence, six-week notification condition, official-delegation exception and 14-day vacatio are preserved. Score 5 versus reference 3 is not itself a publication loss because both publish.

findings.source_fact: Preserves foreign-candidate Polish B2 evidence, alternatives to PESEL, age 26 and qualification requirements, electronic filing to the district-court president and September 2027 date.
findings.qualification: The old full bill is unavailable, so no independent claim about changes since the previous version is established. Score 2 versus reference 1 keeps both below the publication threshold.

findings.source_fact: Four of the first 75 completed none triage rationales are entirely Polish despite the explicit Russian-rationale rule: 1684, 765, 2747 and 2161. The paired medium rationales are Russian.
findings.qualification: These rationales are not reader cards, and language compliance is separate from legal relevance. The calibrated triage prompt reiterates Russian final JSON.

findings.source_fact: The bill adds Greek minority to the national-minority list and a representative to the joint commission, without changing the citizenship definition. Article 2(1) of the underlying act defines national minorities as groups of Polish citizens.
findings.medium: Scores social/3 and relevant=true on Greek-community cultural rights without establishing a non-citizen beneficiary group.
findings.high: Scores social/3 and explicitly names foreigners of Greek origin as potential beneficiaries if they meet the legal minority definition, without explaining its Polish-citizenship requirement.
findings.qualification: The unchanged definition is not reproduced in the supplied bill. This shows insufficient eligibility evidence and a foreigner-channel publication scope error, not an unconditional invented residence entitlement. The stricter calibrated audience checks are still pending.

findings.source_fact: Preserves the operative recognition of foreigner-law documents and no-PESEL identity data for access passes to Sejm/Senate buildings. Score indirect/2 avoids a reader card while retaining a genuine identification procedure.
findings.qualification: Historical triage rejection and Luna passing differ editorially; this full-source result does not establish a legal false-positive triage error.

findings.source_fact: The revision-context answer gives indirect/2 with no changes_since_previous and correctly says the budget funds existing tasks without changing individual rights or conditions. Original primary medium and high both give social/3.
findings.qualification: The revision source is slightly different and includes the reconstructed prior summary, so this is not a controlled identical-request repeat. It nevertheless shows the model's editorial judgment depends on context; max_v2 is tested on both primary and revision inputs.

findings.source_fact: The supplied justification explicitly says art. 66(1)(20a) is supplemented with medical graduates in practical training and persons attending Polish-language/preparatory courses without another mandatory insurance basis; art. 73(4) is adjusted for start/end of insurance. This supports treating course coverage as material rather than merely an unchanged sentence copied into a replacement paragraph.

findings.qualification: The 2025 consolidated-law HTML was unavailable through the web tool; this finding is grounded in the exact supplied bill justification, not an unverified claim about a fetched current consolidation.

findings.source_fact: The only edit adds one ordinary space in kursy języka polskiego; full old and new texts are identical after whitespace collapse. Both already include preparatory courses. Luna nevertheless says courses were added, material=true and confidence=.98.
findings.qualification: An isolated full-context stress test, not an actual historical legislative change. New change_review_v1 checks real OLD-to-NEW differences while retaining dates, amounts, negation and logical scope checks.

findings.source_fact: diff_laws prepares 2353-character normative bodies for 1040, with one hunk for the date and OR/AND edits. For 3141 it prepares 38666 characters; whitespace has zero hunks, and the insurance-negation pair exceeds the 60000-character review cap. The whitespace error cannot trigger an actual production LLM review on this mutation.
findings.qualification: Raw full-context tests remain useful stress evidence but do not establish current production-path failure. Eight follow-up generations compare original and calibrated prompts on the exact eligible production-prepared 1040 contexts.

findings.source_fact: The proposed under-26 entitlement requires collective accommodation before 1 July 2026 followed immediately by daytime school or full-time university education. The answer only says some students under 26 and gives no usable eligibility conditions.
findings.source_excerpt: przebywa lub przebywała w obiekcie zbiorowego zakwaterowania przed dniem 1 lipca 2026 r. ... następnie bezpośrednio kontynuuje naukę ... w formie dziennej ... na uczelni w formie stacjonarnej
findings.qualification: The answer does not explicitly promise eligibility to every student, so classify as loss of actionable conditions rather than an invented universal entitlement. Its major groups, outside-centre healthcare and 14-day vacatio are source-supported; calibrated answers still require comparison.

findings.source_fact: Supplied text confirms functional immunity for official acts, the director condition excluding Polish citizens and permanent residents, personal-import privileges for one year, and 14-day vacatio.
findings.qualification: This verifies named conditions, not a complete audit of the incorporated UN privileges convention.

findings.source_fact: Supplied bill and justification confirm electronic notarial transmission through CREWAN, seven-day existing transmission duty, a fee with amount set by regulation, and three-month vacatio; no new property-permit exemption is asserted.

Supplied normative text confirms the double condition for domestic movable/property-right gifts: neither acquirer nor donor has Polish citizenship or permanent residence/headquarters in Poland. Foreign assets are taxable if the recipient has Polish citizenship or permanent residence. The date belongs to this historical draft, not proof that the proposal became law.

Supplied registry clauses explicitly include foreign lawyers, insurance information and suspension status. Both answers restrict the effect to professional registry access rather than general migration or work-permit changes.
Both original efforts mistakenly infer added preparatory-course eligibility where the only old/new difference is one extra space in full 3141 text.
findings.qualification: Production diff_laws filters this zero-hunk change before model review. Both change_review_v1 efforts correctly return material=false; do not present the original stress error as a current production repost failure.

findings.source_fact: Several real inputs exhaust the 32000-token output budget entirely on reasoning, with no final JSON and incomplete reason max_output_tokens.
findings.qualification: This is a genuine unusable response for the tested configuration, not commentary parsing. Test the same frozen prompt at high before selecting a practical configuration; count exhausted reasoning in paid cost.

findings.source_fact: The short controlled norm expressly permits return to Poland for permanent residents. Original medium/high scored legal_stay 5, precision_v1 high scored indirect 2. Frozen v2 gives medium 2, high 5 and max 2 despite all three describing the direction correctly.
findings.qualification: The production rubric explicitly assigns entry/exit and immigration control score 2, but changes to permanent residence score 5. This short control grants return after travel without changing the residence permit itself, so score 2 is defensible. The old score-5 answer is not a legal oracle, and no score expectation was preregistered. Report classification instability, not an established publication false negative.

findings.source_fact: Full-text high analysis confirms a citizenship-state criminal-record check for non-Polish EU workers but scores it indirect 2. Original none and the historical Haiku reject the excerpts; original medium passes them.
findings.qualification: This is a source-supported triage false negative under the broad procedural-relevance gate, but it is not proven loss of a score>=3 reader card under the current publication threshold. Historical-reference agreement conceals the procedural miss.

findings.source_fact: Earlier exploratory audit called score 2 a regression against original score 5. Direct inspection of production scoring rubric found entry/exit explicitly scored 2; that inference was too strong.
findings.qualification: All configurations preserve the correct direction; this control cannot establish quality deterioration without a clearer substantive residence-entitlement change.

findings.source_fact: All five fresh triage guards pass, including a Polish-citizen-only minority. Real 1889 nevertheless returns affects_foreigners=true with confidence .82 while correctly saying only Polish citizens can get the new widow/widower status; real 2360 passes conservatively at .68 because the supplied excerpt lacks the underlying minority definition.
findings.qualification: Prompt calibration improves explanations and some budget/generic exclusions but does not turn a conservative gate into a precise legal-audience classifier. 1889 is extra analysis cost, not an invented eligibility right or a demonstrated lost bill.

findings.source_fact: Both original and calibrated prompts at medium/high detect the 14-to-30-day vacatio mutation and OR-to-AND entitlement mutation in normative bodies/hunks prepared by the actual production diff_laws pipeline. All eight decisions and their stated effects match the source modifications.
findings.qualification: Eight generated answers represent two controlled source changes, not eight independent legislative events. The large full-3141 negation stress input exceeds the current production review cap and would route to full reanalysis.

findings.source_fact: Frozen v2 at high restores the passport/identity-document option without PESEL and the EU healthcare-coordination personal identifier/institution data omitted by original medium. It restricts reimbursement to already entitled patients and does not invent automatic entitlement. Normative text also confirms the one-year consent, loss of reimbursement after full-price dispensing, and 180-day target-import prescription validity.
findings.qualification: A successful targeted repair on a known omission, not independent blind proof. This same input exhausted 32k output tokens with max; high returns usable JSON with 2015 output tokens, 1552 reasoning, at $0.0082693.

findings.source_fact: High-v2 restores the before-1-July-2026 collective-accommodation condition and immediate full-time education for the under-26 group, and the unmarried/absent-in-Poland husband condition for single mothers. It also preserves pension cap, children under residents care, outside-centre healthcare, declaration and 14-day vacatio.
findings.qualification: The original medium answer used vague some-students wording without actionable conditions. This is a targeted repair, not an independent blind accuracy score.

findings.source_fact: High-v2 now names criminal-record checks for foreign volunteers, but says from countries prescribed by law without the citizenship/residence jurisdictions or ten-year lookback. The supplied norm and historical Opus explicitly name those conditions, especially non-EU volunteers working with children.
findings.qualification: Visa-fee exemption, six-week notice and exception, and 14-day vacatio remain accurate. Test generic conditions_v3 rather than assuming the partly repaired answer is equivalent in actionable completeness.

findings.source_fact: High-v2 corrects score to indirect 2, states no residence entitlement, and mentions other relationships may bar access. It still does not name the supplied foreign-law union rule: barred even when that union is not recognized as marriage under Polish law. Historical Opus names it explicitly.
findings.qualification: No unconditional eligibility promise is made; classify loss of an important foreigner-specific restriction, not an invented new residence right. At score 2 this normally does not generate a reader card.

findings.source_fact: High-v2 rejects publication and identifies Polish citizens of Greek origin, unlike original medium/high that described potential noncitizen beneficiaries. The underlying minority-law citizen definition was independently checked in the primary ELI source.
findings.qualification: The original supplied draft does not quote the whole underlying definition; conservative low-confidence triage passing remains defensible. This does not prove that no indirect language-support effect could ever concern noncitizens.

findings.model_text: При срочном лечении заявление на возмещение можно подать после лечения — в течение 30 дней.
findings.source_fact: The supplied art.42d(3) exception refers to wniosek o wydanie zgody under art.42b(9), submitted within 30 days from completion of urgent life/health-saving treatment in another EU/EEA state. It is a retrospective consent application, not the separate refund application.
findings.source_excerpt: przed złożeniem wniosku o wydanie zgody ... jeżeli następnie złożył taki wniosek w terminie 30 dni od dnia zakończenia tego leczenia
findings.qualification: High-v2 successfully restores course eligibility and the no-other-insurance condition, but coverage improvement does not establish unchanged procedural accuracy. Historical Opus does not introduce this mislabeled deadline. The pending v3 prompt was extended before any v3 generation to distinguish legal procedures; a fresh control uses different consent/refund deadlines.

findings.source_fact: High-v2 includes course participants and medical graduates without other insurance, and correctly calls the retrospective 30-day procedure an application for consent in another EU/EEA state. It also retains the 14-day pension-work notification and staged 14-day/9-month/12-month entry rules.
findings.qualification: The related RCL high-v2 answer mislabels the same procedure as refund, so this one correct answer cannot establish configuration-wide stability.

findings.source_fact: High-v2 restores the missing course groups and preserves the no-other-insurance condition. Its one changes_since_previous bullet correctly distinguishes foreign-doctor evidence for consent from the separate refund procedure; the supplied reconstructed old bullet ambiguously combines refund and that evidence.
findings.qualification: An actual prior saved brief is available but the old full legislative version is not. Treat this as correction of prior description, not proven creation/removal of a provision between bill versions. This context cannot establish historical version-change precision.

findings.source_fact: The foreign-acquirer declaration is source-supported, including the company already owning or becoming an owner/perpetual usufructuary on registration. The answer omits perpetual usufruct, which the historical Opus also omits. Its effective_date states only 1 October 2027, while supplied art.14 and Opus explicitly include some financial-filing provisions effective 1 October 2028.
findings.qualification: The directly discussed foreign-acquirer declaration is in the 2027 part, so this is incomplete whole-law entry wording rather than a demonstrated wrong date for that foreigner duty. Opus score 1 versus Luna 2 does not change the >=3 publication gate.

findings.source_fact: The v3 completeness prompt produces a visa-only answer and omits foreign volunteers and their criminal-record checks in every output field. V2 high had at least mentioned the check, and historical Opus names citizenship/residence jurisdictions and the ten-year period.
findings.qualification: Do not choose the new prompt solely because it repairs another case. The fresh small five-year control passes, demonstrating that passing an isolated control does not establish rich-real-input coverage. An identical high repeat and xhigh/64k with the unchanged v3 prompt are explicitly queued.

findings.source_fact: V3 high explicitly restores the restriction on foreign-law unions not recognized as marriage, adult/legal-capacity exclusions, personal joint attendance, optional PESEL, the 100zl fee and no residence entitlement. Its score changes from v2 indirect 2 to social 3.
findings.qualification: Facts improve, but the publication gate changes. Civil partnership versus social rights is an editorial classification judgment here, not a proven fabricated statutory right. Historical Opus uses 2; report the score variation separately from factual completeness.

findings.source_fact: V3 preserves the score-1 ordinary-budget versus score-3 new-benefit distinction, full work-or-business/tax/child-school exceptions in 1040, and pre-July-2026/immediate full-time study plus single-mother/pension conditions in 3039. Its fresh non-EU volunteer guard correctly uses citizenship/residence states over five years and excludes Poland.
findings.qualification: These selected passing checks coexist with a real Jamboree coverage regression and do not prove universal improvement.

findings.source_fact: All eleven distinct review controls at medium/high match materiality gold: five legal changes and two immaterial small controls, plus four real-corpus mutations (OR/AND, vacatio, insurance negation, spacing). Separately all eight decisions on two exact production-prepared mutations are correct.
findings.qualification: Twenty-two plus eight answers are repeated effort/prompt variants, not thirty independent events. One medium scope rationale is Polish, whereas the corresponding high is Russian; this is a locale defect, not a lost material change. The large raw-corpus stress cases are outside the current production review size cap.

findings.source_fact: The high-v2 answer accurately preserves the main Blue Card 6-month contract, 3/5-year qualification experience, 12/6-month mobility, 150% salary and 15 working-day notification rules, and all three conditions for a foreign caregiver of a Polish child. But its sibling groups are broad: dependent ill siblings of refugees. The normative art.159(5)(2) requires complete and permanent dependence on parents who qualify as parents of an unaccompanied minor refugee and have been granted the family-reunification residence permits. Those limiting conditions do not appear anywhere in the answer. Confidence is .99.
findings.qualification: This is a source-grounded incompleteness in a generally competent detailed answer, not evidence that all listed siblings have automatic residence. No matched fresh Opus answer or paired v3 replay of this case exists. The social-assistance statement is supported by repeal of arts.76/78 and the supplied justification; do not classify it as an invented entitlement merely because it is compressed.

findings.source_fact: High-v2 restores the FGŚP wage-protection mechanism omitted by the original medium answer, and accurately identifies a maximum three-month period and the 30-day main / six-month art.73 commencement split. Source arts.34-38 also set employer/individual application timing, monthly payout caps and unmet claims caused by the restrictive measures. The short answer leaves these to generic conditions-of-law wording.
findings.qualification: Main-topic coverage improved, but this is not a complete actionable explanation of the application procedure. Max32k produced no final answer on this same source.

findings.source_fact: Actual production MessageFormatter renders 127 completed analysis/reanalysis variants with minimal bill metadata within Telegram length limits. Summary, key changes, practical impact, affected groups and effective date all survive in these cards. No paid API call or Telegram delivery was made.
findings.qualification: Does not include real stages, consultation/RCL metadata or update-card rendering, and does not prove factual completeness. It only shows the extra group conditions in these tested answers are not removed by the minimal card renderer.

findings.source_fact: Production token records use disjoint uncached/read/write inputs. Fully cold historical repricing must add all three categories before applying input rates. The earlier cold comparison omitted 5304 Opus cache-write tokens and 2048 GPT-5.1 cache-read tokens. The comparison script now provides corrected cold totals and a separate repricing using observed cache categories. Official Opus5.5 Batch cache read is .10/M, 5-minute write2.50/M; GPT5.1 Batch cached input .0625/M. All measured Luna cache categories remain zero.
findings.qualification: Historical cache-write TTL is not persisted; the observed-cache scenario assumes 5-minute writes. Comparisons remain repriced past usage with different tokenizers/prompts, not fresh matched-model quality runs or future monthly savings. Actual Luna test cost and its $2 budget are unchanged.
